changelog:
- Initial release of wechat-article-formatter skill.
- Provides structured workflow for generating, normalizing, theming, and previewing HTML-first WeChat articles.
- Supports converting topics, briefs, notes, outlines, Markdown, or existing HTML into WeChat-friendly article body.
- Applies reusable style presets with default fallback to "warm-editorial" theme.
- Includes image base64 inlining, complete HTML preview generation, and rigorous style/content QA before delivery.
- Emphasizes one-source HTML workflow, strict preview interaction, compliance with theming/output rules, and prevention of common misuses.
summary: 生成、规范化、主题化微信公众号文章 HTML，并输出可复制或可预览的正文。
